sources.summary: Bochsler links Spanish business to PATVAG, reorganized in spring 1936 as a family trading company: Werner delegated director, Rudolf president, Victor board member in Spain. Its office moved to Zurich Bahnhofstrasse. Early compensation trade exchanged Spanish goods against Swiss export balances; olive oil mentioned. Victor earlier ran CEDRIC with Walther Cetto and worked with Paul Holzach and Hans Heusser. This makes PATVAG a better archival search term than assuming HOVAG as telegram sender. No cipher plaintext or exact police shelfmark appears in preview.
